meta.title: Time Converter — Convert Second and More
meta.description: Free time converter for 9+ units including Second, Millisecond, Microsecond. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Seconds, minutes, hours, days, years. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 9 time units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for time in this tool is **s**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most time conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Second | s |
| Millisecond | ms |
| Microsecond | µs |
| Minute | min |
| Hour | h |
| Day | d |
| Week | wk |
| Month (30 d) | mo |
| Year (365 d) | yr |
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this time converter?
**A:** It uses 9 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Second (s), Millisecond (ms), Microsecond (µs), Minute (min), Hour (h), Day (d), Week (wk), Month (30 d) (mo), Year (365 d) (yr).
